name: AMD Radeon PRO W7900 datasheet (PID 232010504)
notes: AMD's own two-page datasheet, fetched live and text-extracted in full on 2026-10-03 (AMD's current product page for this part 404s; the datasheet PDF is still served and was archived 2024-06-03). TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS table, verbatim: GPU Architecture 'AMD RDNA 3'; Graphics Memory '48 GB GDDR6'; Memory Interface '384-bit'; Memory Bandwidth '864 GB/s'; Error Correcting Code (ECC) 'Yes'; Peak Single-Precision Performance '61.32 Tflops'; Ray Accelerators '96'; PCI Express Support '4.0 Ready (x16) with 3.0 Backward Compatibility'; Total Board Power '295 W'; Cooling 'Active'; Board Form Factor '11in (280 mm), Triple Slot, Full Height'; Display Connectors '3x DP 2.1 & 1x Enhanced Mini DP 2.1'. Key Features list: '48GB GDDR6 Memory with ECC Support', 'Efficient Chiplet Design', '2x AI Accelerators per Compute Unit', '2nd Generation Ray Tracing', 'AV1 Encode (NEW) & Decode', 'DisplayPort 2.1 with up to 77.4 Gbit/s', 'Up to 12K120 display support'. CONVENTIONS: AMD labels the compute figure 'Peak Single-Precision Performance' - i.e. explicitly FP32 and NOT a matrix/AI throughput - and prints NO sparsity row and NO sparsity footnote anywhere on this datasheet, so 61.32 TFLOPS is dense. AMD publishes NO FP16 matrix rate and NO INT8 rate for this card, so those are left null. Memory bandwidth 864 GB/s reconciles: 384 bit x 18 Gbps / 8 = 864 GB/s, i.e. 18 Gbps per pin on GDDR6, which is the standard GDDR6 rate for 384-bit parts of this vintage and is consistent with the sibling Radeon PRO W6800.
